_deploymentCache.description:
Holds {@link Engine.Deployment} object for current instance of {@link Engine}.

For internal use only!

This object may differ from what is stored in the config framework (until it's updated by {@link Engine.Controller}).
Value in config framework may be missing if the engine is been {@link #terminate terminated}.

title:
Base type for "engines" i.e. special types that have a well defined life-cycle.

Engines are persistent between calls, which makes them useful for building caches of expensive data and serving
requests against that cache quickly. These caches should generally be set up during #start, but it may also be
reasonable to cache on demand, as long as #start validates the basic configuration necessary to function.

Typically Engine will be started on-demand when one of the member methods is called. However see
{@link Engine.Daemon} and {@link Engine.Periodic}

Typically this type is not used directly but through a well known sub-type like {@link Action.Engine} or
{@link Lambda.Engine}.

Note that engines are not always singletons but can be as needed.
name: Engine
